channel.title: Jaeheung Lee | Manufacturing & Process Engineer
channel.description: Manufacturing and process-engineering portfolio covering battery production, semiconductor components, equipment FAT/SAT, quality improvement, and manufacturing DX

item.title: Stabilizing 2170 Mass Production by Fixing Measurement First
item.description: Displayed yield, actual good yield, and shop-floor defects did not agree, so measurement and decision reliability had to be checked before process settings. The team recorded 98.7% monthly average good yield in December 2024, and I directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.

item.title: Revalidating 4695 Production Readiness from Initial SAT
item.description: Development and handover were complete, but automatic cycles and vision inspection did not run normally, operators moved each unit manually, and MES history was not recorded correctly. After recovery trials covering about 200 cells in two lots over roughly two weeks, the final 50-cell one-way run achieved FYD of at least 90%, which was used as the limited-production start gate.

item.title: Translating Material and Structure Changes into 25P LFP Process Conditions
item.description: Material and structure changes in the LFP power cell made existing 2170 assembly and inspection settings unsuitable. The team advanced through internal A, B, and C samples, about 20,000-cell initial trial production, customer qualification, and CCB P.O approval. Commercial production did not proceed because of pricing.

item.title: Validating a 2170 Tabless A-Sample Build with Temporary Jigs
item.description: A collector-based Tabless structure differed from the lead-tab process and could not be repeated without dedicated jigs and inspection methods. After about 100 exploratory builds, five samples were suitable for functional checks; a limited same-material, same-cycle comparison indicated lower IR and improved life direction.

item.title: NCM Prismatic Line Acceptance and Early Stabilization Verified in Pilot Production
item.description: Limited FAT samples and individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, repeatability, or readiness for actual production. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.

item.title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul Standardization
item.description: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. Rework and overtime were observed to decrease, while team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.

item.title: High-Temperature Anodizing Film Development for OLED Parts
item.description: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition from legacy-condition parts.

item.title: Technical Qualification of CVD and PECVD Components
item.description: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. Same-sample measurement correlation was established, and the technical qualification conditions were added to QCPs, run sheets, and inspection standards.

item.title: Diffuser Ultrasonic-Stripping Scale-up Failure and Validation Gates
item.description: Lab stripping was possible, but overlapping ultrasonic zones damaged the surface and left roughness, diffusion, and reusability risks unresolved. Normal operation was not achieved; the case established that stripping feasibility and product reusability must be judged separately.

item.title: Indy7 Robot Control and Status Monitoring System
item.description: JSON references had to survive exchanges between the PC and teaching pendant, while robot commands, state, and history needed one coherent flow. Basic Indy7 commands, shared state, work history, and a read-only digital twin were connected; Omniverse is excluded from completed work.

item.title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images
item.description: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. The limited field evaluation exposed the distribution gap and produced an evaluation process that prioritizes missed defects when comparing models and thresholds.

item.title: Factory I/O Virtual Factory Expansion Scenario
item.description: Meeting a target output required checking cycle time, equipment count, and layout before adding equipment. The team connected Factory I/O, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA with a virtual expansion scenario sized to a target output.

item.title: HeungTology for Collecting and Searching Manufacturing Knowledge
item.description: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. The current public main includes the knowledge vault, link-graph index, and sync/query flow.

item.title: Deep Learning Model Study Log
item.description: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.

item.title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates
item.description: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

item.title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions
item.description: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.

item.title: AI Agent Experiment That Checks Evidence Before Acting
item.description: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. The current local-foundation stage studies how decisions vary across LLMs and data and where human approval must remain.

item.title: A Cell S/N Trace Tool Connecting Fragmented Process Data
item.description: Process-level MES data existed, but a cell's full history was not connected, so investigating ten customer-requested cells took about three days. A single search took 5–10 seconds and a ten-cell investigation about three minutes; the tool was used on site during my employment and handed over.

item.title: Alternative Can Supplier Validation and Pilot Supply Transition
item.description: The incumbent supplier could not cover the planned follow-on volume alone, so a new can supplier required manufacturing and quality validation. After 600 cells across three lots and an official UN38.3 pass, purchasing and subsequent pilot production moved to the alternative can after existing stock was consumed.

item.title: NCM Pre-Forming Validation That Replaced Manual Variation with a Jig Standard
item.description: Manual shaping before pre-welding varied by operator and repeatedly created uncoated-edge damage and short-circuit risk. The condition was verified with about 400 samples, used in subsequent pilot production, and reflected in process/inspection standards, the P-FMEA, and production-equipment RFQ.
